handouts.title: DASH Diet Guide - A Heart-Healthy Approach to Eating
handouts.description: A practical guide to the DASH diet for patients managing blood pressure and cardiovascular health. Covers what to eat, portion guidance, sodium targets, and how the diet reduces blood pressure.

handouts.title: Eating Out on a Low Carbohydrate or Ketogenic Diet
handouts.description: Practical guidance for eating out on a low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diet. Covers how to navigate restaurant menus, what to order, what to avoid, and how to handle social situations without compromising your diet.

handouts.title: Electrolyte Replacement on a Ketogenic Diet
handouts.description: How to maintain healthy electrolyte levels on a ketogenic diet. Covers sodium, potassium, and magnesium — food sources, supplement options, and how to manage keto flu symptoms.

handouts.title: Your Guide to the Ketogenic Diet
Hypoglycemia Recognition and Management
handouts.description: How to recognise and treat low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia). Covers symptoms, the 15-15 rule, when to call for help, and prevention strategies for patients on insulin or sulfonylureas.

handouts.title: Myth-Busters: Can I Do This Long Term?
handouts.description: Evidence-based answers to the question: can I follow a low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diet long term? Covers long-term clinical trial evidence, sustainability research, the maintenance phase, common challenges and how to address them, and what long-term success looks like in practice.

handouts.title: Myth-Busters: Is it Safe to Eat Low-Carb with Diabetes?
handouts.description: Evidence-based answers to the question: is it safe to follow a low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diet with diabetes? Covers how low-carb diets lower blood sugar, why medication adjustment is essential, what monitoring is required, and what the clinical trial evidence shows.

handouts.title: Low-Carb Diets: Separating Science from Fad
handouts.description: Evidence-based answers to the question: is a low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diet just another fad? Covers the history of carbohydrate restriction back to the 1800s, the clinical research base, evolution of dietary guidelines, and why this approach is grounded in metabolic science rather than trend.

handouts.title: Myth-Busters: What About Fibre?
handouts.description: Evidence-based answers to the question: will I get enough fibre on a low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diet? Covers why fibre does not count toward your carb target, high-fibre low-carb food sources, gut health on low-carb, and what the evidence shows about fibre intake on carbohydrate-restricted diets.

handouts.title: Myth-Busters: Why Do I Feel Worse Before I Feel Better? (Keto Flu)
handouts.description: Evidence-based explanation of keto flu — why some patients feel worse before they feel better when starting a ketogenic diet. Covers electrolyte shifts, sodium loss, common symptoms and their timeline, and practical strategies for managing the transition period.

handouts.title: Myth-Busters: Why is my LDL going up?
handouts.description: Evidence-based explanation of why LDL cholesterol may rise on a low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diet. Covers LDL particle size, the triglyceride to HDL ratio as a better cardiovascular marker, why total LDL is not the whole story, and when a rising LDL warrants further investigation.

handouts.title: Myth-Busters: Will I Be Deficient in Vitamins and Minerals?
handouts.description: Evidence-based answers to the question: will I be deficient in vitamins and minerals on a low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diet? Covers the micronutrient density of low-carb foods, electrolytes, magnesium and potassium on keto, what to monitor, and when supplementation makes clinical sense.

handouts.title: Myth-Busters: Won't a High Fat Diet Give Me a Heart Attack?
handouts.description: Evidence-based answers to the question: won't a high fat diet give me a heart attack? Covers the history of dietary fat and heart disease, LDL particle size, triglyceride to HDL ratio, and what the current evidence actually shows about low-carbohydrate diets and cardiovascular risk.

handouts.title: Myth-Busters: Won't This Damage My Kidneys?
handouts.description: Evidence-based answers to the question: won't a high protein or low-carbohydrate diet damage my kidneys? Covers the protein-kidney myth, what the evidence shows for healthy kidneys, when CKD is a genuine concern, and what monitoring is appropriate.

handouts.title: Peri-Procedural Rules for Low-Carb/Keto Diabetic Patients
handouts.description: Essential rules for patients on low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diets before surgery, procedures, or bowel preparation. Covers when to stop low-carb eating, medication adjustment, minimum fasting periods, and when to contact your clinic.

handouts.title: Reading Food Labels on a Low Carbohydrate or Ketogenic Diet
handouts.description: How to read food labels on a low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diet. Covers net carb calculation, hidden sugars, misleading health claims, and how to compare products at a glance.

handouts.title: Spanish Mediterranean Diet Guide
handouts.description: A practical guide to the Spanish Mediterranean diet. Covers the principles of traditional Spanish Mediterranean eating, key food choices, what to avoid, olive oil as the primary fat source, and the role of fish, legumes, and vegetables in this diet pattern.

handouts.title: Managing Illness Safely on Your SGLT2 Medication
handouts.description: Sick day rules for patients taking empagliflozin (Jardiance), dapagliflozin (Forxiga), or canagliflozin (Invokana). When to hold your medication, ketone monitoring, and when to seek emergency care.

handouts.title: Understanding My Carbohydrate Targets
handouts.description: Understanding your prescribed carbohydrate target. Covers net carb calculation, what your daily target means in practical food terms, how carbs are distributed across meals, and what to do if you go over your target.

handouts.title: Understanding Sugar Substitutes - Patient Handout
handouts.description: A practical guide to sugar substitutes on a low-carbohydrate or ketogenic diet. Covers which sweeteners are safe, which to avoid, their effect on blood sugar and insulin, and how to use them without compromising your diet goals.
